== Template:Item/General ==

Template for displaying general/miscellaneous item tooltips (quest items, materials, currency, etc.). Supports optional activatable effects.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Item name
|-
| '''description''' || No || Item description/lore text
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''stack_size''' || No || Maximum stack size
|-
| '''disposable''' || No || Set to any value if item is consumed on use
|-
| '''effect_style''' || No || Effect type: "Activatable" for click effects
|-
| '''effect_spell_name''' || No || If set, displays spell effect details
|-
| '''effect_*''' || No || Various effect parameters (see Item/SpellDetails)
|}

=== Examples ===

==== Basic General Item ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/General
|image=Chunk of Copper Ore.png
|name=Chunk of Copper Ore
|description=A fancy metal ore.
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/General
|image=Chunk of Copper Ore.png
|name=Chunk of Copper Ore
|description=A fancy metal ore.
}}

----

==== General Item with Activatable Effect (Keeper's Lantern) ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/General
|image=Keeper's Lantern.png
|name=Keeper's Lantern
|description=Rest a while in the glow of the flame, and allow the memory of its light to guide you home.
|effect_style=Activatable
|effect_spell_icon=Light of the Lantern.png
|effect_spell_name=Light of the Lantern
|effect_spell_level=25
|effect_spell_type=Misc
|effect_spell_line=Generic
|effect_cast_time=2.7
|effect_special_descriptor=Set respawn point. Use with caution!
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/General
|image=Keeper's Lantern.png
|name=Keeper's Lantern
|description=Rest a while in the glow of the flame, and allow the memory of its light to guide you home.
|effect_style=Activatable
|effect_spell_icon=Light of the Lantern.png
|effect_spell_name=Light of the Lantern
|effect_spell_level=25
|effect_spell_type=Misc
|effect_spell_line=Generic
|effect_cast_time=2.7
|effect_special_descriptor=Set respawn point. Use with caution!
}}

----
